name: toast
purpose: Transient notifications stacked in a labelled region (section aria-label 'Notifications') rendered in the top layer with popover=manual. Each toast is announced once through the shared live regions (polite for info/success, assertive for warning/error), never steals focus, pauses while hovered or focused, and can be reached with a hotkey (default Alt+T) and dismissed with Escape.
whenToUse: Confirmation of a completed background action (saved, sent, copied).
Non-blocking notices with at most one follow-up action, such as Undo.
Errors from background work, which persist until dismissed by default.
whenNotToUse: Information the user must not miss or must act on: use Alert or Dialog.
Field validation errors: show them at the field and in the Error Summary.
Status tied to a specific place on the page: use Inline Message.
Long or rich content: toasts are text only with one action.
responsive: Region width min(toast-width, 100vw - 2rem), pinned to the configured corner or centred; toast text wraps.
rtl: Positions use logical insets: 'end' is the right edge in LTR and the left edge in RTL.
theme: Opaque color-surface under the tone's color-{tone}-subtle tint, color-{tone}-fg icon and border, color-text body text, shadow-md. Forced-colors mode removes the tint and uses CanvasText borders.
security: Title, message, and action label are rendered with textContent; never parsed as HTML. CSP-safe (styles only from the stylesheet and CSSOM).
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. Messages are copied into the shared live regions for announcement.

performance.testedScale: Queueing tested with more toasts than max; at most max (default 3, limit 20) toasts are in the DOM at once.

limitations: Toasts already visible when a modal dialog opens stay beneath it until the next toast is shown, which moves the region into the dialog.

The shared announce() live regions live in document.body; while a modal dialog is open they are outside the dialog and screen readers may not announce toasts (to be addressed in the utilities package).
There is no exit animation; toasts are removed immediately. The entry slide/fade is removed under reduced motion or animation 'none'.
matchesHotkey compares event.key, so Alt+letter hotkeys may not match on macOS where Option changes the produced character; configure a different hotkey there.
Queued toasts that are dismissed before they appear emit no events.
unsupported: HTML or Node content in toasts.
More than one action per toast.
antiPatterns: Putting the only copy of important information or the only path to an action in a toast.
Short durations for long messages; keep at least 5 s and let errors persist.
Showing a toast for every keystroke or poll result.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/toast: AuiToaster service (inject(AuiToaster).show()) configured with provideAuiToaster(); no directive.
